info.name: 📌 Hugging Face API
info.description:
### About Hugging Face

"We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science."

Hugging Face hosts open models and routes requests to partner inference providers, such as Cerebras, Groq, Together and Novita, through one OpenAI-compatible router. On the workspace overview it is listed under **Inference hosts**.

### Prerequisites

- Postman Account
    
- Hugging Face Account: [https://huggingface.co/](https://huggingface.co/)
    

### Usage

1. Create a fork
    
2. Update collection variables
    
3. Send requests (on 503 due to model loading, wait and retry)

Start with the 🚀 Get Started folder.

Add these keys to your **Postman Vault** as `hugging_face_api_key`, `openai_api_key`, `google_gemini_api_key`, `anthropic_api_key` (Vault icon in the footer, then **Add secret**, using these exact names). Requests read them as `{{vault:hugging_face_api_key}}` and so on, so your key never leaves your device.

### Documentation

- API: [https://huggingface.co/docs/api-inference/index](https://huggingface.co/docs/api-inference/index)
    
- Models: [https://huggingface.co/models](https://huggingface.co/models)

item.description:
### Retrieval-Augmented Generation

Patterns include:

- Naive RAG (retrieval & generation)
    
- Advanced RAG (retrieval & generation with retrieval pre- and post-processing)
    
- Agentic RAG (multi-model multi-step inference using tools)
    

Use cases include:

- Question Answering
    
- Recommendation System
    
- Article Writing
    

### Agentic AI

Frameworks include:

- crewAI
    
- LangGraph
    
- AutoGen
    
- OpenAI asynchronous stateful Assistants API
    

Use cases include:

- Tool Calling
    
- Article Writing
    
- Chess
    
- Code Generation & Execution
    
- General AI Assistant
    

### Source

- [https://huggingface.co/bstraehle](https://huggingface.co/bstraehle)

- Fireworks AI: [https://huggingface.co/models?inference_provider=fireworks-ai&sort=trending](https://huggingface.co/models?inference_provider=fireworks-ai&sort=trending) (15+ models)
    
- Replicate: [https://huggingface.co/models?inference_provider=replicate&sort=trending](https://huggingface.co/models?inference_provider=replicate&sort=trending) (10+ models)
